# AlgoQuest Production Lake

> Versioned production data for AlgoQuest images, prompt packets, research and job dependencies.

- Agent index: /algoquest-production-lake/agent/index.json
- Prompt packets: /algoquest-production-lake/agent/packets.json
- Prompt packet details: /algoquest-production-lake/agent/packet-details.json
- Books: /algoquest-production-lake/agent/books.json
- Image slots: /algoquest-production-lake/agent/image-slots.json
- Research sources: /algoquest-production-lake/agent/research-sources.jsonl
- Jobs: /algoquest-production-lake/agent/jobs.json
- Human guide: /algoquest-production-lake/

The public site is read-only. Do not place learner data, credentials, private correspondence or raw secrets in proposals.
